layout: Satellites in orbit, targets on ground
legend: Show satellite modes and target types

critical_relations.pointing: satellite pointing direction means satellite is aimed at direction
critical_relations.have_image: satellite have_image direction mode means image was taken
critical_relations.power_on: instrument power_on means instrument is active
critical_relations.calibrated: instrument calibrated direction means instrument is calibrated for that direction

positioning_rules: Satellites should be shown in upper portion (orbit)
Targets/directions should be shown in lower portion (ground)
Show pointing direction with lines or arrows

turn_to.description: When satellite turns to point at a direction
turn_to.visual: Draw arrow/line from satellite to target direction, highlight satellite
turn_to.code_hint: ctx.setLineDash([5,5]); drawArrow(ctx, satX, satY, dirX, dirY);

switch_on.visual: Instrument glows green, add power indicator LED
switch_on.code_hint: ctx.fillStyle = '#4CAF50'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(instX+5, instY-5, 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

switch_off.visual: Instrument returns to gray, power LED turns off

calibrate.description: When instrument is calibrated for a direction
calibrate.visual: Draw crosshair on instrument, add 'CAL' badge
calibrate.code_hint: ctx.strokeStyle = '#2196F3'; drawCrosshair(ctx, instX, instY, 8); ctx.fillText('CAL', instX+10, instY);

take_image.description: When satellite takes image of target
take_image.visual: Flash effect, camera icon, mark target as captured
take_image.code_hint: ctx.fillStyle = '#FFD700'; ctx.fillText('📷', targetX, targetY-10); // Camera icon on target

state_indicators.pointing_at: Dashed line from satellite to direction
